run_OnCallJob: run an OnCallJob instance to spin up Turk-as-Oncall HITs and collect dashboard session logs
create_OnCallJob: create an OnCallJob with a specified number of ECS instances, image tag, and timeout value
process_s3_logs: process S3 interaction logs for a batch and return a map of agent IDs to log directories
get_local_db_results: retrieve Mephisto local DB results for a task and upload summary stats to S3
get_batch_id: get the unique batch ID generated for an OnCallJob instance
